amnesia.definitionKo: 충격을 받아서 이전의 어느 기간 동안 있었던 일을 생각해 내지 못하는 일. 또는 그런 병.
amnesia.englishDescription: The state of not being able to recall an event during a certain period in the past because of a shock, or such a disease.

amnesia.definitionKo: 충격을 받아서 이전의 어느 기간 동안 있었던 일을 생각해 내지 못하는 병.
amnesia.englishDescription: A disease of not being able to recall an event during a certain period in the past because of a shock.

buck-passing.englishDescription: An act of avoiding taking responsibility for something.

indeul.definitionKo: 어떤 조건을 인정한다고 하여도 그 결과로서 기대되는 내용이 부정적임을 나타내는 조사.
indeul.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to admit to a certain condition but imply the possibility of a negative result.

launching.definitionKo: 상품이 시중에 나옴. 또는 상품을 시중에 내보냄.
launching.englishDescription: The state of a product being released on the market, or an act of releasing a product on the market.

line.definitionKo: 영화나 연극에서 배우가 하는 말.
line.englishDescription: Words spoken by an actor or actress in a movie or play.

line.definitionKo: 가로나 세로로 그은 금이나 줄. 또는 어떤 물건의 윤곽.
line.englishDescription: A line drawn either horizontally or vertically; or the outline of a certain thing.

line.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서, 경기장의 경계나 구역을 나타내기 위해 그은 선.
line.englishDescription: In a sports game, lines drawn to mark the boundary or zones of a playing field.

line.definitionKo: 기업의 생산 공장에서 생산되는 물건의 제조가 진행되는 과정.
line.englishDescription: The manufacturing process of a product done in a company's production factory.

line.definitionKo: 가로나 세로로 그은 금이나 줄.
line.englishDescription: A border or line drawn horizontally or vertically.

line.definitionKo: 사물의 윤곽.
line.englishDescription: The outline of something.

line.definitionKo: 정해진 기준이나 정도.
line.englishDescription: A set threshold or degree.

line.definitionKo: 사람이나 물건이 길게 죽 늘어선 줄.
line.englishDescription: A row or line made by a group of people or things arranged in a line.

line.definitionKo: 사람이나 물건이 길게 죽 늘어선 줄을 세는 단위.
line.englishDescription: The unit for counting the number of lines of people or things.

line.definitionKo: 서로 비슷한 성질의 것들이 속해 있는 분야.
line.englishDescription: A domain where things with similar qualities belong together.

line.definitionKo: 하나의 공통적인 것에서 갈려 나온 갈래.
line.englishDescription: A branch splitting from one common thing.

line.definitionKo: 버스, 기차, 비행기 등이 정기적으로 오가는 일정한 두 지점 사이의 정해진 길.
line.englishDescription: A fixed path between one point and another, regularly traveled by a bus, train, plane, etc.

line.definitionKo: 목표를 이루기 위해 따르는 견해나 행동의 지침.
line.englishDescription: A guideline for views or actions that one follows to achieve a goal.

line.definitionKo: 학문적인 약간의 글.
line.englishDescription: A piece of academic writing.

line.definitionKo: 접거나 긋거나 하여 생긴 자국.
line.englishDescription: A mark formed when one folds or draws something.

line.definitionKo: 시조나 사설에서 어절을 세는 단위가 되는 짧은 토막.
line.englishDescription: In traditional Korean three-verse poetry or narratives, a phrasal segment that serves as a unit for counting the number of syntactic words.

line.definitionKo: 줄을 지어 늘어선 무리.
line.englishDescription: A group of people standing in a row.

line.definitionKo: 여럿이 일정하게 늘어선 줄.
line.englishDescription: A row of people lining up at uniform interval.

line.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 길게 줄지어 섬. 또는 그런 행렬.
line.englishDescription: People lining up in a long line, or such a line.

line.definitionKo: 앞으로 일을 해 나갈 일정한 방향이나 계획.
line.englishDescription: A certain direction or plan of doing something from now on.

line.definitionKo: 어떤 기준이나 어떤 상태에 있음.
line.englishDescription: A state of being up to a certain standing or in a certain situation.

line.definitionKo: 전기를 보내고 받거나 전화 통화를 하기 위하여 설치한 전기 회로.
line.englishDescription: An electric circuit installed to send out and receive electricity or talking on the phone.

line.definitionKo: 사람이나 물건이 길게 늘어서 있는 것.
line.englishDescription: The position of people or things being lined up.

line.definitionKo: 길게 늘어서 있는 사람이나 물건을 세는 단위.
line.englishDescription: The unit of counting people or things being lined up.

line.definitionKo: 글을 가로나 세로로 늘어놓은 것.
line.englishDescription: A group of words that are arranged horizontally or vertically.

line.definitionKo: 가로나 세로로 늘어놓은 글을 세는 단위.
line.englishDescription: The unit of counting a group of words that are arranged horizontally or vertically.

line.definitionKo: 길게 바로 그어진 선.
line.englishDescription: A long line that is drawn straight.

line.definitionKo: 시에서 나타난 하나하나의 줄.
line.englishDescription: Each line in a poem.

line.definitionKo: 주름이나 구김으로 생기는 선.
line.englishDescription: A line of wrinkles or creases.

line.definitionKo: 넘어서서는 안 되는 일정한 수준. 또는 알맞은 한도.
line.englishDescription: A certain level or appropriate limit that should not be exceeded.

line.definitionKo: 한 줄.
line.englishDescription: One line or row.

line.definitionKo: 지하철의 각 노선을 이르는 말.
line.englishDescription: A bound noun used to refer to each line of a subway.

line.definitionKo: 위에서 아래로 긋는 줄.
line.englishDescription: A line drawn from top to bottom.

line.definitionKo: 나란히 줄을 이루다.
line.englishDescription: To form a line by being side by side with each other.

line.definitionKo: 물체에 깊지 않게 팬 줄이나 금.
line.englishDescription: A shallow groove or crack in an object.

line.definitionKo: 여럿이 줄을 지어 감. 또는 그런 줄.
line.englishDescription: A state in which many people move along in a line; or such a line.

line.definitionKo: 글을 가로나 세로로 늘어놓은 것.
line.englishDescription: A group of words that are arranged horizontally or vertically.

line.definitionKo: 가로나 세로로 늘어놓은 글을 세는 단위.
line.englishDescription: The unit of counting a group of words that are arranged horizontally or vertically.

line.definitionKo: 나이가 많거나 지위가 높은 사람이 차리고 나서서 길을 감. 또는 그때 줄을 지어 이루는 사람들의 무리.
line.englishDescription: A state in which a person who is older or higher in ranking is dressed up and set off on a trip to a place; or a crowd of people gathering to see such a trip.

line.definitionKo: 통신이 가능하도록 설치된 선.
line.englishDescription: A line installed for communication.

obscenity.englishDescription: An expression that arouses people's sexual desire and corrupts public morals.

questioning.definitionKo: 잘못이 있는 사람에게 죄, 잘못 등을 따져 묻거나 심문함.
questioning.englishDescription: The act of questioning or interrogating a guilty person about his/her wrongdoings or crimes.

questioning.definitionKo: 이미 알고 있는 일이 사실인지 거짓인지 확인하기 위하여 캐물음.
questioning.englishDescription: The act of questioning inquisitively in order to confirm whether an already known fact is true or false.

respondent.englishDescription: A person who answers someone's call or question.

snare.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 남을 잡거나 가두기 위해 여러 곳에 마련해 둔 함정 등의 망.
snare.englishDescription: (figurative) A trap or snare installed in several places to catch or lock up someone.

snare.definitionKo: 끈이나 철사 등으로 고리를 만들어 짐승을 잡는 데 쓰는 도구.
snare.englishDescription: A ring-shaped tool made of rope or wire that is used to catch animals.

snare.definitionKo: 새나 짐승을 잡는 데 쓰는 고리 모양의 장치.
snare.englishDescription: A loop-shape device used for catching a bird or animal.

snare.definitionKo: 꾀를 써서 다른 사람을 곤란하게 만들다.
snare.englishDescription: To get someone into trouble by using a trick.

snare.definitionKo: 짐승을 잡기 위해 파 놓은 구덩이.
snare.englishDescription: A pit dug for catching an animal.

snare.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 남을 어려움에 빠뜨리거나 해치기 위해 꾸민 일.
snare.englishDescription: (figurative) A plot to get another person into trouble or hurt him/her.

yama.definitionKo: 불교에서, 죽은 사람이 살아 있을 때 한 일의 잘잘못을 심판하는 저승 세계의 왕.
yama.englishDescription: The king of the underworld in Buddhism who judges the right and wrong of the actions a dead person did when he/she was alive.
